name: Turned knob
description: A revolved profile with a central shaft bore and a chamfered top.
print_notes: Print broad base down, shaft bore vertical. Default design: support-free FDM in PLA/PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers. Bore includes 0.4 mm total clearance for a nominal 6 mm shaft; test fit before a final print.
